items.exampleEn: This old coin is worth a lot of money.
The river is very broad near the sea.
items.exampleZh: 這條河在靠近海的地方很寬。

items.exampleEn: My grandmother is still very active at eighty.
items.exampleZh: 我奶奶八十歲了還是很活躍。

items.exampleEn: My chief worry is the cost of the trip.
items.exampleZh: 我最主要的擔心是旅費。

items.exampleEn: The rules of this game are quite complex.
items.exampleZh: 這個遊戲的規則相當複雜。

items.exampleEn: His mistake was obvious, but nobody said anything.
items.exampleZh: 他的錯誤很明顯，但沒有人說什麼。

items.exampleEn: This tea has a unique taste.
items.exampleZh: 這種茶有一種獨特的味道。

items.exampleEn: The company is holding an internal meeting today.
items.exampleZh: 公司今天要開內部會議。

items.sentenceEn: Do you think this museum is worth a visit?
items.sentenceZh: 你覺得這間博物館值得一去嗎？

items.audioEn: Only staff can read this email because it is an internal message.
items.audioZh: 只有員工可以看這封郵件，因為這是內部訊息。

items.sentenceEn: The chief problem is that we don't have enough time.
items.sentenceZh: 主要的問題是我們時間不夠。

items.sentenceEn: Every cup in this shop is unique because it is made by hand.
items.sentenceZh: 這家店的每個杯子都是獨一無二的，因為都是手工做的。

items.stemEn: This math problem is too ____ for young children.
items.stemZh: 這道數學題對小孩子來說太複雜了。

items.stemEn: Stay ____ and do some exercise every day.
items.stemZh: 保持活躍，每天做點運動。

items.passageEn: Our city's old train station is unique: it is the only station in the area built of red stone, and it is almost one hundred years old. The chief reason it is still standing is that local people have been active in protecting it. Last year, the city held an internal discussion about the station's future. The question was complex, but in the end the answer seemed obvious: the station is worth keeping. Today, it stands on a broad street, with shops and a small museum inside.
items.passageZh: 我們城市的老火車站很獨特：它是這一帶唯一用紅色石頭蓋的車站，而且已經快一百歲了。它到現在還在的主要原因，是當地居民一直積極地保護它。去年，市政府內部討論了這座車站的未來。這個問題很複雜，但最後答案似乎很明顯：這座車站值得保留。現在，它位在一條寬闊的街上，裡面有商店和一間小博物館。

questions.questionZh: 這座車站有什麼特別之處？
options: 是全國規模最大的車站
是這一帶唯一的紅石車站

questions.questionZh: 市政府最後的決定是什麼？

referenceEn: I think this book is worth reading.
This book is really worth reading.
rubricZh: worth＋動名詞，表示「值得⋯」（例如 worth reading）
worth 前面要有 be 動詞
寫 worth a read 也正確

items.promptZh: 這座城市的建築風格很獨特。
referenceEn: The buildings in this city have a unique style.
The style of the buildings in this city is unique.
rubricZh: 用 unique 表示「獨特的」（例如 a unique style、is unique 等）
「建築風格」可寫，例如 the style of the buildings、the buildings have a … style 等
